text:
cheng: CI red on PR #1327 — pre-commit fails (rustfmt) + frontend eslint + one flaky runtime test. Report: https://ci.redwood.dev/job/1327 :eyes:

ci-bot: Build 1327 failed. Failed jobs: pre-commit.format, frontend-eslint, runtime-tests::cache_invalidation (flaky). Snapshot:
```
pre-commit: running rustfmt... error: file src/generated/protos.rs changed after formatting
frontend-eslint: src/components/toast.tsx:12:5 - 'any' is not allowed (no-explicit-any)
runtime-tests: tests::cache_invalidation - thread 'tests::cache_invalidation' panicked at 'assertion failed', src/tests/cache.rs:48
```

alex: can someone rerun the failed jobs? I don't have perms for rerun-all right now. :pray:

marta: on it, kicking rerun for the three failed jobs. will post results.

ci-bot: Rerun started by marta for jobs: pre-commit.format, frontend-eslint, runtime-tests.

ci-bot: Rerun complete — still failing: pre-commit.format, frontend-eslint. runtime-tests passed on rerun (likely flake).

samir: @cheng @marta I'll start a git bisect locally on the repo to find which commit introduced the formatting/toolchain change. ping me if you have a known-good SHA.

cheng: last known good on main was 89a7c2 (before toolchain bump). Note: there was a merged change that regenerated protos and touched generated/ — could be the root. Also eslint failure points to toast.tsx where we recently introduced a generic event payload.

julia: quick suggestion: if the proto file is generated, maybe exclude generated/ from rustfmt in pre-commit or add rustfmt::skip on generated file header. For the eslint one we could add a narrow inline "// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any" but I don't love ad-hoc disables.

samir: bisect steps I'm running:
```
git fetch origin
git checkout main
git bisect start HEAD 89a7c2
# automated test script to run pre-commit and eslint
git bisect run ./tools/ci/check_format_and_lint.sh
```

samir: git bisect identified first bad commit: 6f3d2b3 — "update rustfmt/toolchain and regenerate protos". The diff shows rustfmt config tightened to max_width=100 and reformatting generated/protos.rs.

cheng: OK that matches my suspicion. So two things: 1) generated code change causes pre-commit format diffs, 2) eslint caught a real typing issue. For the generated code, I can open a tiny PR to either pin rustfmt/toolchain or add an exclusion for generated/ in pre-commit. For eslint I'll fix toast.tsx with a proper type instead of any.

marta: plan sounds good. If you open the PR, mark it "ci: exempt generated from fmt" and include the bisect info in the description so reviewers know it's a toolchain/regeneration issue. I'll approve the rerun after merge.

cheng: creating PR now — link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/2345 — includes: add generated/ to format-exclude, fix toast typing, pin rustfmt to 1.5 via rust-toolchain file. Running CI on that branch.

ci-bot: CI started for PR 2345. Will report back.

alex: thanks all. good triage. :thumbsup:

julia: we should add a short note in CONTRIBUTING.md about regenerating protos and running `./tools/ci/check_format_and_lint.sh` locally to avoid surprises.

cheng: agreed — adding that to the PR too.
